📖 Guide

❌ Tic Tac Toe

Controls: Tap a cell to place your mark.

Objective: Get 3 of your marks in a row, column, or diagonal before your opponent.

Winning Rules: Play vs AI (Easy/Medium/Hard/Impossible). First to complete a line wins; a full board with no line is a Draw.

Rewards: Win as X vs AI for Remo — Easy +2, Medium +5, Hard +10, Impossible +15. A Draw earns +7 Remo.

🪨 Rock Paper Scissors

Controls: Tap Rock, Paper, or Scissors.

Objective: Beat the AI's pick each round.

Winning Rules: Rock beats Scissors, Scissors beats Paper, Paper beats Rock. Matching picks is a Draw.

Rewards: +10 Remo for every round you win.

🔵 Dot It — Dot & Boxes

Controls: Tap any open line between two neighboring dots.

Objective: Complete more boxes than your opponent by drawing the fourth side of a box.

Winning Rules: Completing a box gives you another turn. When every box is filled, the player with the most boxes wins.

Modes: Play against Easy, Medium, Hard or Impossible AI, or play 2 Player on the same device.

🏓 Pong

Controls: Choose 🤖 1 Player (vs AI) or 👥 2 Player before starting. Drag anywhere on your own half to move your paddle freely - not just left-right, but anywhere within your half. In 2 Player mode both players can drag at the same time on the same device.

Objective: Return the ball past your opponent's paddle to score.

Winning Rules: First player to reach the Win Score wins the match. Adjust the Win Score anytime from the settings row above the table. In 1 Player mode, pick Easy/Medium/Hard/Impossible AI difficulty.

Rewards: Complete Daily Tasks based on Pong points scored for bonus Remo.

🧠 Memory Match

Controls: Tap cards to flip them.

Objective: Find all 10 matching pairs across 20 cards.

Winning Rules: Match all pairs to complete the board; unmatched pairs flip back over.

Rewards: Hints unlock permanently after winning 2 games, +1 Hint every 2 wins after that, plus Daily Task Remo rewards for completed games.

🤖 AI Number Duel

Controls: Pick a secret number, then guess the AI's number using the Higher/Lower/Correct buttons and your own guess field.

Objective: Guess the AI's secret number before it guesses yours.

Winning Rules: There is no guess limit. Keep guessing until you correctly find the AI's secret number, while the AI keeps narrowing down your secret using Higher/Lower/Correct. Answer honestly about your own secret — the AI uses true binary search and will catch impossible answers.

Rewards: Complete Daily Tasks for Duel wins to earn bonus Remo.

🔢 Number Slide

Controls: Tap a tile touching the empty space, swipe on the board, or use arrow keys / WASD on desktop.

Objective: Arrange the numbered tiles in order — 1, 2, 3… left to right, top to bottom — with the empty space last.

Winning Rules: Only a tile touching the empty space can move into it. Swiping a direction moves the tile on that side of the gap into the gap. The puzzle is solved once every tile reads in order.

Rewards: Fewer moves and a faster time score higher — every mode tracks its own best time and move count separately.

📖 How To Play

1
Arrange the numbers

Slide tiles until they read 1, 2, 3… in order, left to right, top to bottom, with the empty space last.

2
Move into the empty space

Only a tile touching the empty space can move. Tap it, or swipe/press an arrow key.

3
Tap, swipe, or type

Tap a movable tile, swipe on the board, or use arrow keys / W A S D on desktop.

4
Fewer moves, faster time

Your score rewards efficient, speedy solutions — but any solve beats none!

5
Chase your best

Every mode tracks its own best time and move count. Beat your record!

A swipe moves the tile in that direction into the empty space:
